claims: The 2026 Chinese Grand Prix Sprint race is scheduled for Saturday, March 14, at 11:00 AM local time (CST) in Shanghai.
11:00 AM CST on Saturday, March 14, in Shanghai is 3:00 AM GMT.
11:00 AM CST on Saturday, March 14, in Shanghai is 10:00 PM ET on Friday, March 13, in the US.
The 2026 Chinese Grand Prix Sprint covers 100km.
The 2026 Chinese Grand Prix Sprint determines points and the starting grid for the weekend.
2026 Chinese Grand Prix Sprint Qualifying is Friday, March 13, 7:30 PM - 8:14 PM CST.
2026 Chinese Grand Prix Sprint Race is Saturday, March 14, 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM CST.
2026 Chinese Grand Prix Qualifying is Saturday, March 14, 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM CST.
The 2026 Chinese Grand Prix Sprint format consists of a 100km race with no mandatory pit stops.
The 2026 Chinese Grand Prix Sprint provides points to the top eight finishers.
